falsifier: Reject immediately for causal-test failure, nondeterminism, invalid execution, insolvency, nonpositive no-control OOF Sharpe, fewer than four positive folds, nonpositive bull/bear/chop return, nonpositive long-bull or short-bear attribution, nonpositive doubled-cost Sharpe, or drawdown above 40%. Risk controls cannot rescue a failed base mechanism.
selection_rule: Pass all causal, regime, sleeve, doubled-cost, drawdown, fold and stability gates; among survivors maximize median fold Sharpe, then minimize drawdown and turnover.
thesis: High-volume price moves unexplained by rolling BTC beta and reinforced by same-side funding partly reflect temporary forced-flow impact. A diversified long/short tail portfolio should earn the subsequent liquidity-provision reversal.
